t: Bayer Teams up with Schering-plough
s: March 27, 2023 - Bayer says the new unit will promote certain Schering-Plough cancer products in the U.S. and Europe. Bayer's Viadur (leuprolide), a treatment for prostate cancer, will also be marketed by the unit. The specialty pharmaceuticals business will market Bayer's Kogenate FS (recombinant antihemophilic factor), a hemophilia drug, and Trasylol (aprotinin), a drug used in open-heart surgery. The Schering deal follows Bayer's recent decisions to buy Roche's over-the-counter drug business and spin off its commodity chemicals unit, Lanxess, to shareholders.
